مقدمة
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block.
Water Treatment is used in several purposes like drinking, industrial used and 
 services
Water Treatment at Ataka Power Station consists of:
1)
 Demineralization system
2)
 Raw water treatment
3)
 Make-up water system
4)
 Drinking water
We focus on Demineralization system which can be used to remove the salt content 
 of the water after the KSU-reactor nearly completely so that it can be used as 
 make up water for the boiler.
The Principal Parts of the Demineralization Plant are :
1.
 Activated charcoal filters (1x drinking water)
2.
 Caction exchangers
3.
 CO2-sprinklers
4.
 Double stage anion exchangers
5.
 Mixing-bed exchangers
6.
 Regenerative station
7.
 Neutralization plant
For Testing Water Treatment Plant 
 perform the following:
1. Check control valves on pipes and filters tank levels.
2. Check tank levels
3. Check instruments & measuring devices (ph, conductivity) .
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mohamed Gomaa, tested by eng Waled Nasr, revised by EDEPC quality control 
 eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 Al-Emam, accepted by eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed: general manager, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.
